context_requirements: Intact KEAP1-NRF2 axis; KEAP1 mutations or NRF2 activation may blunt further induction
Basal oxidative stress or electrophilic tone to allow measurable NRF2 derepression
Expression of NRF2 (NFE2L2) and small MAF proteins
Cellular capacity for glutathione synthesis and phase II conjugation
falsifiers: No induction of canonical NRF2 target genes such as HMOX1, TXNRD1, or GCLM at 6 h in any line
Strong and consistent upregulation of cholesterol biosynthesis genes (e.g., HMGCR, HMGCS1) across lines
Predominant downregulation of antioxidant response genes at both time points
No transcriptional response at either 6 h or 24 h in all nine lines

evidence.supports: Nrf2/small Maf heterodimer mediates induction of phase II detoxifying enzyme genes through antioxidant response elements
Keap1 represses Nrf2 nuclear activation; electrophiles antagonize Keap1 inhibition to potentiate the ARE response
Nrf2-ARE pathway controls expression of detoxication and antioxidant genes in response to oxidative stress
Antioxidants such as N-acetylcysteine and glutathione peroxidase counter apoptotic death, linking antioxidant mechanisms to cell survival
